dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Multiple thin, high-contrast white horizontal bands are clearly visible across the greater and median coverts against a darker grey-brown background.

other_distinctive_markers: Continuous high-contrast scalloped/scaled pattern across the entire visible dorsal surface from crown to tail coverts.
